metadata.description: Vyomi, the local AWS / GCP / Azure simulator, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other coding agents.

plugins.name: vyomi
plugins.description: Run and test cloud code locally against Vyomi (Nano in the browser, or a Pro/Max mesh): scan a repo for AWS/GCP/Azure usage, see what is emulated where, wire SDKs to it, and add it to AGENTS.md. Needs vyomi-tunnel 1.3.0+ (1.4.0+ for the AGENTS.md step).

plugins.name: vyomi-cloud
plugins.description: Run and test cloud code locally against Vyomi through its hosted MCP server at https://vyomi.cloud/mcp: ask what the AWS/GCP/Azure simulator emulates, get the SDK settings and code for your simulator, scan a repo with rules it hands you, and get a .env.vyomi and an AGENTS.md section to apply yourself. No install and no tunnel; read-only, and it never sees your machine or your code.
